agentActionExecuting: Execution was started. Do not repeat it; check the relevant page or contact support to reconcile an interrupted action.
agentActionExpired: This review expired. Ask the agent to prepare a fresh review with current details.
providerBaseUrlHelp: For compatible providers: https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, https://api.mistral.ai/v1 or https://api.x.ai/v1. Other endpoints require server configuration.
tokenPriceHelp: Optional provider prices for estimates. Leave blank when unknown. These are not billing totals.
agentKeysHelp: Configure your own Gemini, OpenAI, Claude or compatible key using API Keys in the left sidebar. Never paste keys into chat.
agentDemoHelp: Demo mode uses preset examples. Select a configured provider for natural-language conversations.
agentUsageHelp: Provider-reported tokens from this app. App message limits and provider limits are separate.
agentNoProviderUsage: No provider requests recorded this month. Demo mode consumes no provider tokens.
unmeteredRequests: requests have no reported token usage; totals are partial.
agentCostHelp: Estimates use configured USD token prices. Cache discounts, cache writes, taxes and other fees are not modeled; actual bills may differ.
providerLimitsUnavailable: This provider did not return rate-limit headers.
providerQuotaHelp: Account-wide credits and quotas are unavailable from chat responses. Check the provider dashboard. Headers are a snapshot, not a live balance.
AI_RATE_LIMITED: The provider rate or quota limit was reached. Check its dashboard and retry after the limit resets.
AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT: The conversation exceeds the context limit. History is preserved. Choose a larger-context model or start a new conversation.
AI_TIMEOUT: The provider timed out. Your history and prepared reviews are saved; check them before retrying.
AI_OUTPUT_LIMIT: The provider response was cut short. Your history and prepared reviews are saved. Ask to continue.
AI_INVALID_RESPONSE: The provider did not return a valid structured response. History is preserved; retry or choose another model.
AI_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED: Use a listed HTTPS endpoint or ask the administrator to configure it.
AI_STEP_LIMIT: The agent reached its step limit. Review prepared actions, then ask it to continue.
AI_RUN_IN_PROGRESS: A request is running. Reopen the conversation after it finishes. Interrupted requests can be resumed after 15 minutes.
AI_INTERRUPTED: The request was interrupted. History and prepared actions are preserved. Review them before continuing.
AI_REQUEST_EXISTS: This request was already submitted. Reopen the conversation to check its result.
AI_HISTORY_INVALID: The conversation history could not be loaded safely.

creditExplanation: Your next steps focus on consistent payments, manageable utilization and reviewing your record. This is educational guidance.
riskExplanation: Your funding deadline and available cash determine the most immediate risk. Review the tool results and confirm your next action.
familyPrivacy: Parents manage family sharing and approval rules. Private AI conversations are never shared with parents.
planTrial: Try the essentials for seven days.
paymentNote: Demo cards only. Never enter real card details. No card number or CVV is stored.
authSubtitle: One home for your finances, wherever life takes you.

demoParent: Support a student and review financial approvals.
demoAdmin: Explore plans, financial datasets and audit evidence.
demoReset: Demo reset tokens are shown only for demo accounts. Other accounts require administrator support in this competition version.
resetSent: If an eligible demo account exists, a reset code is shown below.
subject: Subject
familyLater: You can invite a parent from Family after setup.
heroTitle: Your money. Your future. Beyond borders.
heroSub: The AI finance companion that helps international students plan tuition, send smarter and feel at home with their money.
allConnected: One life. Many currencies. All connected.
authSecurity: Hashed passwords, expiring sessions and account revocation.
approvalSecurity: Sensitive actions need explicit, one-use approval.
auditSecurity: Every financial action leaves a verifiable evidence trail.
aboutBody: A FinTechathon 2026 International Track project for cross-border and student finance. Built around deterministic tools, human approvals and auditable sandbox execution.
termsBody: This competition application provides financial simulations and educational planning. It does not move real money, provide banking services or make lending decisions. Use fictional data in shared demo accounts.
privacyBody: Financial records stay in your database. Family access follows student permissions. Optional OpenAI mode sends the goal and requested financial tool results to OpenAI. Export your data or close your account in Settings. Audit evidence is retained.
tuitionApproaching: Your tuition deadline is approaching. Review your funding plan.
shoppingBudget: Shopping is above its monthly budget.
favorableRate: Compare the latest stored sandbox exchange rates.
assessmentBody: Authenticated Server Actions validate inputs and ownership. Decimal arithmetic, database transactions, deterministic risk checks and one-use approval tokens protect sandbox execution. Parents see only student-approved fields.
limitationsBody: Sandbox providers and FX rates are fictional. No bank integrations, live FX, email delivery or official credit scoring. Production needs HTTPS, credential rotation, backups, deployment-specific rate limits and an independent security review. Shared demo accounts are for fictional data only.
evidenceIntro: Goal → tools → risk → approval → sandbox execution → verification → evidence.
databaseUnavailable: The database is unavailable. Check your local environment and run database setup.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the form fields and try again.
NOT_FOUND: This record is no longer available.
PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached your plan limit. Choose a plan with more capacity.
PARENT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Parent approval is required before execution.
RISK_BLOCKED: Risk checks blocked this transfer. Review balances, limits and deadline.
TRANSFER_FAILED: The transfer failed and was rolled back.
AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider is unavailable. Check configuration or use mock mode.
DATABASE_ERROR: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
EMAIL_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
INVALID_TOKEN: This approval or reset code is invalid or expired.
SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED: Your subscription has ended. Choose a plan to continue.
ACCOUNT_NOT_EMPTY: Move the balance before archiving this account.
CSV_INVALID: CSV is invalid or exceeds 2,000 rows.
INVALID_STATE: This request has already changed. Refresh its status before continuing.
ROLE_LINKED: Revoke family connections before changing roles.

CATEGORY_LIMIT_REACHED: This expense exceeds a linked parent’s monthly category limit.
fxHistoryNote: Stored sandbox rates for 1 RMB. Illustrative rates, not live market data.
photoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP · maximum 300 KB
catalogHelp: Add a currency first, then choose it as a country’s default.
apiKeyPrivacy: Keys are encrypted on the server. Personal keys are private; shared models use administrator-managed keys. Saved keys are never sent back to the browser.
modelNameHelp: Enter the exact model ID available in your provider account.
keyReplaceHelp: When editing, leave blank to keep the saved key.
label: Label
savedCardHelp: Only demo-card references, labels, expiry and last four digits are saved. Full card numbers and CVVs are never stored.
saveCard: Save this demo card for next time
teamMission: People making cross-border student finance easier to understand.
teamEmpty: No team profiles have been published yet.
teamAdminHelp: Create staff logins, choose permitted admin sections and publish team profiles.
moderatorBoundary: Moderators can access only assigned sections. They can edit only their own picture, email and portfolio within their team profile.
noSearchResults: No matching pages or records. Try an account name or a page such as Wallet.
STUDENT_NOT_FOUND: The student needs an active registered account with this email first.
parentManaged: Your parent manages this family circle and its payment rules.
visualGuide: From a goal to a verified result
journeyBody0: Connect your sandbox balances in BDT and RMB. Choose your current country and preferred currency.
journeyBody1: Set a tuition deadline, living-cost budget or family transfer goal. See what is available and what is still needed.
journeyBody2: The assistant uses financial tools to compare fees, exchange rates and arrival times. Choose the model you want to use.
journeyBody3: Balance, ownership, limits and deadlines are checked on the server. An AI recommendation cannot bypass these controls.
journeyBody4: Parents manage family rules and may waive their approval step. The student still confirms the exact payment before simulation.
journeyBody5: A successful simulation updates balances together and preserves the receipt, tool results and audit trail.
bordersBody: Plan your next chapter between Bangladesh and China, with BDT and RMB at the centre. Other countries and currencies are welcome too.
projectWalkthrough: Demonstrate the workflow using recorded runs, tools and receipts.
securityReviewIntro: Review access boundaries, approval controls and safeguards.
securityNotCertification: This is a sandbox self-assessment, not an independent security certification or a real banking service.
PENDING_PAYMENTS: Finish or cancel your pending payments before closing or clearing this account.
autoLowBalance: Your combined balance is below RMB 500. Review your upcoming expenses.
autoTuitionOverdue: An unpaid tuition deadline has passed.
autoTuitionDue: An unpaid tuition deadline is within 30 days.
autoFundingGap: The tuition plan still has a funding gap. Review the planner.
autoBudgetExceeded: Spending has exceeded a current monthly category budget.
autoLargeExpense: A recent expense of at least RMB 10,000 deserves review.
autoSubscriptionDue: Your subscription expires within seven days.
autoQuotaNear: At least 80% of a plan allowance has been used.
autoFxMovement: An account currency moved by at least 2% against RMB compared with the stored rate a week ago. Demo rates are illustrative.
AI_PROVIDER_BUSY: The AI provider is temporarily overloaded. Your request was not lost; retry shortly or choose another model.
EXPIRED: This review has expired. Ask the agent to prepare it again.
ACTION_FAILED: This action could not complete. Check its status before trying again.
financialPolicyHelp: These ceilings apply to both payment requests and transfer simulations. Parent limits may be stricter.
creditGuidanceHelp: Choose which educational checklist items appear for each country. Unconfigured countries use the default.
featuresIntro: Explore the tools for everyday money, study goals and family support.
howIntro: Follow a request from your first instruction to its final receipt.
securityIntro: See who can access your data, what requires approval and how money movements are recorded.

studentPreviewBody: Compare tuition, housing and daily costs before asking for support.
familyPreviewBody: In this example, family support closes RMB 1,500 of the tuition gap.
homePlanBody: Set a study goal and see what you need to save each month.
homeFundBody: Use a demo card or request a manual deposit through a supported payment method.
homeShareBody: Parents manage limits and approvals while shared views respect family visibility settings.
paymentPathsBody: Choose a method to see how its request moves through the application.
walletPathHelp: Parent approval applies when current limits require it. Eligible wallet transfers complete after confirmation.
cardPathHelp: Card details belong in the payment form. Only the documented demo cards are accepted.
manualPathHelp: Bank, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay and UnionPay requests wait for an authorized operator. Deposits are credited only after approval.
securityDataBody: Every view and action is checked against the signed-in user's role and ownership.
keptIdentity: Profile and preferences for your account experience.
keptLedger: Transaction records, approval decisions and settlement history.
keptKeys: Encrypted provider keys; only their last four characters are shown.
keptCards: Demo card tokens, expiry and last four digits. No full card number or CVV.
modelBoundaryBody: AI can prepare a payment request. It cannot write database queries, grant parent approval or settle an external transfer.
manualBoundaryBody: External methods in this demo use a manual settlement queue. The application does not connect to payment networks or send real funds.
AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: This model is unavailable for this API key. Edit the model name in AI settings or ask your administrator.
AI_KEY_REJECTED: The AI provider rejected this key or its permissions. Check the saved API key.
AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The AI provider quota is exhausted or unavailable for this model. Check provider billing and limits, or select another model.
AI_REQUEST_REJECTED: The provider rejected the request. Check that this model supports financial tools.
USE_WALLET_ACCOUNT: Cash records cannot fund payments. Choose a bank, wallet or savings account.
paymentWorkflowHelp: RMB and BDT first. Wallet transfers settle in-app; external payments are processed manually. Sandbox only.
paymentReviewHelp: The amount will be reserved after confirmation. Parent rules apply. External requests wait for manual processing. No real money is sent by this demo.
createWalletFirst: Create a wallet in My money before making a payment.
manualDepositHelp: Use the displayed demo platform details and include your reference. Your balance is credited only after an authorized reviewer verifies the deposit.
noCardInChat: Use only demo payment details. Enter card details in the payment form, never in AI chat.
settlementHelp: Mark Processing before handling the request. Mark Completed only after verifying the deposit or recording the external payout, and include a reference. Failed or rejected outgoing requests release reserved funds.
beneficiaryHelp: Student beneficiaries require approval from linked parents. Editing a destination requires a new beneficiary and new approval.
beneficiaryDestinationHelp: For a wallet, enter the registered email. For other methods, enter the recipient name and bank or payment account details. Never enter a password or CVV.
methodCurrencyHelp: Comma-separated active currency codes, for example CNY, BDT, USD.
PAYMENT_METHOD_DISABLED: This payment method is currently unavailable.
UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY: This payment method does not support the chosen currencies.
RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE: The recipient needs an active wallet in the chosen currency.
BENEFICIARY_PENDING: The beneficiary needs approval or is unavailable.
NON_BENEFICIARY_LIMIT: This exceeds the one-time recipient limit. Link a parent or use an approved beneficiary.
PAYMENT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Enter a deposit or settlement reference.
USE_PAYMENT_FLOW: Use Add money to fund this wallet through a payment request. New wallets start at zero.
budgetReviewHelp: Confirm these suggested allocations for the current month. Existing matching categories will be updated together.
